messages:
maria: pushed a tiny PR that replaces the KV cache dashboard example with a version that uses the new per-route cache hit/miss metrics. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/487
kevin: looking now. does the example assume the new metric names (cache_hits_total / cache_misses_total) or the legacy ones?
jin: new names — we renamed them in telemetry v2 in the infra migration. PR should mention migration steps.
maria: yeah I updated the text but not the SDK snippet. good catch.
kevin: also, the trace/context example still shows the old header name. we should standardize on x-rd-trace-id everywhere. cc @sam for rollout concerns.
sam: if we switch headers we'll need a tiny passthrough in the API gateway for 2 weeks to support both. can we land docs first or do infra first? :thinking_face:
maria: plan: land docs with a note + migration section, then infra will deploy passthrough. I'll add a deprecation warning block.
jin: for the SDK snippet, prefer this minimal Python example so folks can copy-paste: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
from redwood.tracing import Tracer

tracer = Tracer(service="my-app")
with RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']) as c:
    span = tracer.start_span("inference")
    headers = {"x-rd-trace-id": span.context.trace_id}
    resp = c.generate("Summarize this...", headers=headers)
    span.finish()
```
kevin: perfect. add a note about cases where users need to pass trace_id via SDK vs relying on auto-instrumentation.
maria: added a short section: "When to pass trace headers manually" + example of a serverless cold-start where auto-instrumentation might not propagate.
sam: about dashboards — can we include the PromQL snippet that computes cache hit ratio across routes? makes it easier for customers.
maria: added this query: ```promql
sum(rate(cache_hits_total[5m])) by (route) / (sum(rate(cache_hits_total[5m])) by (route) + sum(rate(cache_misses_total[5m])) by (route))
```
jin: small nit: use > 0.01 buffer to avoid divide-by-zero weirdness in the UI. 
kevin: also fixed two dead links in the migration guide (old tracing reference). replaced with /docs/observability/tracing-context.
maria: thanks — left one final TODO to update the console screenshot (new legend names). I'll attach a screenshot in the PR.
docs-bot: PR #487 merged by maria — changelog entry created (category: docs). :tada:
kevin: awesome, will follow up with the infra passthrough plan and a rollout note for customers.
sam: assigning post-deploy follow-up to @jin to validate dashboards after infra change. :white_check_mark:
jin: will run synthetic checks and add a quickscript in scripts/verify-cache-metrics.sh.
maria: great teamwork — thanks y'all. closing this thread once screenshots uploaded. :thumbsup:
